intro: The distribution pack, for selling from vans on routes: load a van, sell and collect at each stop, count it back at the end of the day, keep track of crates and deposits, and bill storage clients each month if you run a warehouse for others. Switch the pack on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs.
start: Turn the distribution pack on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs, at your warehouses.
Add your vans and routes on Routes and van loads, and put each customer on a route for a weekday.
Add your returnable items, such as crates and bottles, with their deposit, on Empties and deposits.
Start your first van load, send it out, and settle it when it comes back.

articles.title: Load a van and sell along its route
articles.summary: Start the day's load, put the goods on, send the van out, and enter what was sold and paid at each stop.
before: The van, the route and the customers on it for that weekday are set up on Routes and van loads.

steps.rest: choose the van, the route and the day, then press Start the load.
and add the goods going out, with how many and the price each. The load sheet fills in.
when the van leaves. Its stops are the route's customers for that weekday, in order.
at each customer. Enter what was sold, then what was paid by each method.
and tick The delivery failed if it did: the goods stay on the van. Press Save the stop.
when the van returns. It waits on Settle a van to be counted.

tips: A stop cannot sell more than is left on the van, and payments cannot be more than was sold there.
If a delivery would leave a customer holding more crates than their limit, it is refused and you are told how many must come back first.
To take crates back from a customer, choose Record a collection from their actions on Empties and deposits.

articles.title: Settle a van at the end of the day
articles.summary: Count the money, stock and empties the van brings back against what it sold, and deal with anything that does not agree.

steps.rest: on the van under Vans back.
enter the money counted for each method.
enter what is left of each line. What it should be is shown beside it.
enter the empties that came back against those expected.

steps.lead: Press See what it comes to.
steps.rest: Each difference is shown, with what it means.
A small cash shortfall within your tolerance clears; every other difference goes to the driver's account for review.
Charge the driver or Write it off for each one.

articles.title: Bill your storage clients for the month
articles.summary: Record each client's pallets and goods in and out, work out the month from their rate card, and make the invoices.
before: Each client has a rate card. Add one with Add a rate card, and add clients with Add a client.

steps.rest: for a client each day, with how many are in the cold room, and press Record the count.
for pallets received, cases sent and any service, and press Record it.
and press Work out the month. Each client's storage, in and out, insurance and total are shown.
then Make them. One invoice is made for each client, and the month is fixed.

tips: Pallets are charged on the month's average or its peak, whichever the client's settings say.
A client below the monthly minimum on their rate card is topped up to it.
Insurance is left off for a client who insures their own stock.
